request.style: English, sparse modal folk, haunting low female vocal, open-tuned acoustic guitar, hammered dulcimer, cello drone, frame drum, solemn and searching, 84 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Early in the morning Abraham got up before the light
Saddled up the donkey, split the wood and tied it tight
Took the boy he loved, his only son, and walked for three long days
Till he saw the mountain rising in the distance through the haze

[Verse]
He laid the wood on Isaac and he took the fire and knife
And the boy looked up and asked him on the road toward the height
Here are the fire and the wood
But where is the lamb for the burnt offering?

[Chorus]
God himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son
And the two of them walked on together
On the mountain of the LORD it will be provided

[Verse]
He built an altar on the hill and laid the wood in place
He bound the boy and raised the knife with sorrow on his face
An angel of the LORD called out, Abraham, from the sky
And there behind him in a thicket was a ram caught nearby

[Bridge]
Here I am
Do not lay a hand on the boy
Now I know that you fear God
Since you have not withheld your son, your only son

[Chorus]
God himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son
And the two of them walked on together
On the mountain of the LORD it will be provided

[Outro]
The LORD Will Provide
The LORD Will Provide
